rationale: Describes a conventional SAP transport tool that collects objects into transport requests and moves them between system environments, with change-management automation for delivery. No AI or ML functionality is mentioned.
evidence_spans: Rev-Trac is a SAP Bolt on tool useful to transport the R/3 objects from one environment to another environment in case of multiple system landscapes.
Rev-Trac holds the various transport requests under which the objects are collected.
